messages:
maria: FYI after the deprec banner push i9m seeing admin UI v1 counts drop ~30% starting at 03:20 UTC. feels like attribution, not real traffic loss.
ben: same. quota engine shows steady usage; console per-version buckets fell.
josh: quick suspicion: the banner cookie injection may be affecting headers. envoy filters reorder when cookie plugin is present.
irene: logs show many requests missing X-Client-Version in the exact window. token still present.
ben: example repro: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Client-Version: v1" https://api.redwood.dev/generate` -> upstream lost the header after envoy.
ben: theory: cookie payloads >4k cause lua filter path to skip header passthrough.
maria: why doesn't quota match then?
josh: quota calculation happens earlier in the pipeline from token -> tenant resolution. console attribution uses post-filter header to decide v1/v2. two different signals diverged.
irene: action items: 1) hotfix envoy filter order to preserve X-Client-Version, 2) backfill attribution from token->tenant->route mapping for the affected window, 3) annotate console and surface a short banner.
ben: i'll push envoy reorder canary in 10m.
josh: i'll build a backfill job to recompute per-version timeseries and emit a synthetic metric `platform.v1_attr_backfill`. smoothing window 5m.
irene: add telemetry guard: if quota-derived vs header-derived per-version delta >15% within 10m of a rollout, pause rollout and alert #eng-oncall.
maria: console UX: small notice on admin panels: "Version attribution may be incomplete for 2026-04-18 03:20-03:50 UTC while we reconcile metrics."
deploy-bot: canary deploy started for envoy reorder (deploy/eng-platform) build 2026.04.18-9.
ben: canary passed, rolling to 50%.
josh: backfill started, ETA 40m; will post results here.
